# NepalAI Studio

> NepalAI Studio is a next-generation multilingual AI Video Generation & Creative Suite powered by Azure OpenAI Sora-2, GPT-Image 2.5 Flare, photorealistic Digital Presenter Avatars, HamroAI cultural LLM (GPT-4o & GPT-5-mini), 24kHz broadcast neural speech synthesis, and a browser-based multi-track timeline video editor.

## Core Capabilities
- [Azure Sora-2 AI Video Studio](https://studio.nepalai.tech/sora): High-definition video generation with native 4s, 8s, and 12s durations, 1080p rendering, and continuous character locking.
- [AI News Presenter & Storyteller Avatars](https://studio.nepalai.tech/avatar): Photorealistic AI digital presenters with natural lip-sync, customizable newsroom backdrops, and 4K export.
- [HamroAI Multilingual Assistant](https://studio.nepalai.tech/hamroai): Cultural intelligence engine fluent in Nepali (Devanagari script), Romanized Nepali, Hindi, and English.
- [Dynamic Character Continuity Engine](https://studio.nepalai.tech/character-continuity): Prompt context analyzer powered by GPT-4o enforcing subject visual DNA and sequence consistency.
- [CapCut-Style Multi-Track Video Editor](https://studio.nepalai.tech/video-editor): Non-linear video timeline editor with B-roll tracks, audio mixing, speed curves, auto-subtitles, and visual effects.
- [Neural Audio & Voiceover Studio](https://studio.nepalai.tech/tts-studio): 24kHz broadcast neural voiceover synthesis in Nepali, English, and South Asian voices.
- [AI Art & Image Studio](https://studio.nepalai.tech/image-studio): OpenAI GPT-Image 2.5 Flare and Black Forest Labs FLUX.1 high-resolution art generator.
